## Getting Here
:::

::: {.prose-left}
**From Warsaw — 300 km.** S17 south-east towards Lublin, then route 17 to Zamość. Three and a half to four hours, most of it dual carriageway.

**From Lublin — 90 km.** Route 17 to Piaski, then route 74 south-east. One to one and a half hours.

**From Kraków — 300 km.** A4 east to Rzeszów, then route 19 north and route 74 across to Zamość. Four to four and a half hours.

**Airports.** Lublin (LUZ) is about 85 km away — roughly an hour by road, with connections to Warsaw, London and other European cities. Rzeszów-Jasionka (RZE) is about 120 km. We can arrange a private transfer from either; send us your flight details.

**Parking.** Free, in our own yard behind the building, monitored by CCTV. There is always space, so nothing to reserve. The nearest EV charger is 200 m away.
:::

::: {.host-block}
::: {.host-monogram}
RK

::: {.host-text}
### Your host — Robert

I live here in Zamość and look after both apartments myself. I speak English and Polish, and I answer WhatsApp within a few hours — usually a lot sooner.

Tell me roughly when you expect to arrive and I will fit the handover around it. Ask me where to eat, too: I will point you at the places we go to ourselves rather than the ones with the biggest menus on the square.
:::

[Questions]{.section-subtitle}

## Frequently Asked
:::

::: {.faq-list}

<details>
<summary>What time is check-in and check-out?</summary>

Check-in is between 16:00 and 21:00, check-out by 11:00. Those are the default hours, not a rule — tell us your arrival time in advance and we will usually work around it.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Is parking available?</summary>

Yes — parking in our yard is free, monitored by CCTV, and there is always space for guests. Nothing to book. The nearest EV charger is 200 m away.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Are pets allowed?</summary>

No. We do not take pets in either apartment.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Do you offer airport transfers?</summary>

We can arrange a private transfer from Lublin airport (LUZ, about 85 km) or Rzeszów-Jasionka (RZE, about 120 km). Send us your flight number and arrival time and we will organise a driver.

</details>

<details>
<summary>What is included in the apartment?</summary>

Bed linen, towels and toiletries. A kitchen with dishwasher, hob, oven, fridge and coffee-making things. A washing machine, air conditioning, fibre WiFi and a smart TV with streaming. You will also find our own notes on where to eat and what to see.

</details>

<details>
<summary>What is the cancellation policy?</summary>

Free cancellation up to 7 days before arrival. The exact terms for your dates are shown before you confirm the booking.

</details>

<details>
<summary>How far is the Old Town?</summary>

Rynek Wielki is about 850 m from our door — 10 to 15 minutes on foot. The synagogue is 650 m, the Town Hall 800 m, Bastion VII 1.2 km. Once you have parked the car you will not need it again.

</details>

<details>
<summary>How do I book an apartment at Orlicz 32?</summary>

Use the calendar on our [booking page](book.qmd), message us on [WhatsApp](https://wa.me/48508209313), call [+48 508 209 313](tel:+48508209313) or email [info@orlicz32.pl](mailto:info@orlicz32.pl). Booking direct never costs you more than going through a platform.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Is Zamość worth visiting?</summary>

Zamość was built from scratch in 1580 to an Italian architect's plan for an "ideal city", and it has been a UNESCO World Heritage site since 1992. The Renaissance layout survived intact — a square of exactly 100 by 100 metres, arcaded merchant houses, the fortifications. Two days is enough to see it properly, and it is far quieter than Kraków.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Do the apartments have a washing machine?</summary>

Yes, both apartments have one.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Can I arrange early check-in or late check-out?</summary>

Often, yes — it depends on whether anyone is arriving or leaving on the same day. Ask a day or two ahead and we will confirm it.

</details>

<details>
<summary>What is the nearest airport to Zamość?</summary>

Lublin airport (LUZ), about 85 km away, roughly an hour by road, with connections to Warsaw, London and other European cities. Rzeszów-Jasionka (RZE) is about 120 km. Warsaw is 300 km, three and a half to four hours on the S17.

</details>

:::
